<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/network-orders/{networkRef}/shipment-confirmation"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The one write endpoint of this context (ADR 0014). Tells the network that the order has shipped (`submitShipmentConfirmations`), moves the order to `CONFIRMED` and publishes `NetworkOrderShipmentConfirmed`. Takes no request body.

The trigger is an explicit call naming the `networkRef` rather than a `PackageManifested` correlation, because no persisted mapping from a work unit back to a `networkRef` exists (ADR 0014).

Idempotent twice over: the request carries a required `Idempotency-Key` (fleet REST guideline section 2) whose first answer is stored and replayed with `Idempotency-Replayed: true`, and an order already `CONFIRMED` is still returned unchanged with 204, without re-submitting to the network or re-publishing the event, when a NEW key is used. The route is registered only when the shipment-confirmation use case is wired.
